coverPool.name: Own Damage
coverPool.description: Covers physical loss or damage to the insured vehicle caused by an accident, fire, theft, or natural disaster.

coverPool.name: Third Party Liability
coverPool.description: Covers legal liability of the insured to third parties for bodily injury or property damage arising from vehicle use.

dependencies.condition: For this product — see PRD-002 for standalone TP

coverPool.name: Personal Accident
coverPool.description: Pays a fixed benefit to the insured driver and occupants in case of accidental death or permanent disability resulting from a road accident.

coverPool.name: Theft & Total Loss
coverPool.description: Covers total loss or theft of the insured vehicle. Triggered when repair costs exceed 75% of the vehicle's agreed value.

coverPool.name: Roadside Assistance
coverPool.description: Provides up to 3 roadside assistance call-outs per year, with towing up to 50km. Fixed-fee add-on linked to Rating Studio as flat premium.

coverPool.name: Windscreen Extension
coverPool.description: Covers repair or replacement of the windscreen, rear window, and side glass panels. No impact on No Claims Discount.
